**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Android Engineer**
**ConvergeSPORTS (USI) | Senior Consultant**
**About The Role**
ConvergeSPORTS is a product-driven business combining Deloitte's sports industry experience with proprietary data, AI-native decision intelligence, and reusable Converge capabilities. We help sports organizations grow revenue, deepen fan engagement, optimize partnerships, and improve commercial performance while operating with the focus of a product company. Our teams work with leagues, teams, venues, rights holders, media organizations, sponsors, and brands across fan data, digital experiences, and commercial analytics.
  
  
This role sits within the Mobile App product team. The ConvergeSPORTS Mobile App is a fan-facing digital product that brings together content, identity, engagement, personalization, notifications, and commercial experiences. The team owns the end-to-end fan journey and works with Architecture, iOS and Android Engineering, Backend Engineering, Data, Design, and Go-to-Market to deliver measurable releases.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role. You are the person closest to the Android codebase, accountable for the quality, performance, and stability of what fans actually experience on their devices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Build the Android Experience**

* Design, build, and maintain native Android features for the ConvergeSPORTS Mobile App using Kotlin and modern Android architecture patterns
* Implement and consume RESTful APIs that power content, identity, personalization, and notification experiences
* Translate requirements, wireframes, and prototypes from Product and Design into production-ready Android code

**Own Quality End to End**

* Write unit and UI tests, participate in code reviews, and hold the line on code quality
* Optimize app performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency across a wide range of Android devices
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, using crash reporting and analytics to find root causes

**Ship as One Team**

* Work day to day with iOS and Backend Engineering to keep the fan experience consistent across platforms
* Manage Play Store release cycles, including versioning, staged rollouts, and crash monitoring
* Partner with Product and Design through sprint planning, reviews, and the daily calls that keep delivery moving

**Work Across the Network**

* Contribute to shared components, libraries, and mobile engineering standards used across the portfolio
* Mentor engineers around you and raise the standard of Android craft on the team

**Reporting Relationships**
Reports to Li-Shen Lee. Works as one team with iOS Engineering, Backend Engineering, Design, and Quality Engineering, and partners with Product Management on roadmap and release decisions.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
* 3+ years of professional experience developing native Android applications in Kotlin or Java
* Experience with modern Android architecture, including MVVM, Jetpack Compose or XML-based UI, and Coroutines or RxJava
* Experience integrating RESTful APIs into a production mobile application
* Experience writing unit and UI tests for Android
* Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

**Preferred**

* Experience publishing and maintaining apps on the Google Play Store, including staged rollouts and crash monitoring
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines for mobile build and release automation
* Exposure to iOS development or cross-platform frameworks such as Kotlin Multiplatform or Flutter
* Experience in sports, media, or consumer entertainment mobile products

**Core Competencies**

* Builds reliable, maintainable mobile experiences rather than quick fixes
* Methodical debugger who gets to root cause
* Comfortable in a fast-paced, product-driven environment with shifting priorities
* Clear communicator with product, design, and non-technical stakeholders
* Curious about mobile platforms and emerging Android capabilities

**Why This Role Matters**
Fans judge the product by what happens on their phone. This role owns that surface on Android, from the architecture decisions nobody sees to the frame rate everybody feels. It is where strong mobile engineers do their best hands-on work on a product with real audiences watching.

title: Robotic Engineer - Internship
description:
Internship Opportunity – Robotics Design & Development Engineer

**Company:**
AerX Space Labs

**Division:**
Robotics, Autonomous Systems & AI

**Position:**
Robotics Design & Development Intern

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Internship Duration:**
3–6 Months

**Eligibility:**
Engineering students, final-year students and recent graduates

**Internship Type:**
Full-time / Project-based

About AerX Space Labs

AerX Space Labs is focused on developing next-generation intelligent robotic and autonomous systems, including aerial drones, quadruped robotic dogs, autonomous ground robots and underwater robotic platforms.

We are looking for
**highly motivated, technically capable and hands-on robotics interns**
who can quickly contribute to the design, development, assembly, programming and testing of real-world robotic systems.

This opportunity is intended for students who have already built robotics projects and are passionate about transforming engineering concepts into functional prototypes.

Key Responsibilities
  
1. Robotics Design & Mechanical Development

* Design robotic structures, chassis, joints, mounting systems and mechanical assemblies.
* Develop 3D CAD models using SolidWorks, Fusion 360, CATIA or equivalent tools.
* Support mechanical design for quadruped robots, autonomous ground vehicles and robotic mechanisms.
* Select motors, actuators, gearboxes, bearings and mechanical components.
* Support 3D printing, fabrication, prototype assembly and mechanical testing.

2. Electronics & Embedded Systems

* Select and integrate microcontrollers, sensors, motor drivers and communication modules.
* Work with Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi or NVIDIA Jetson platforms.
* Integrate servo motors, BLDC motors, encoders, IMUs, LiDAR and cameras.
* Assist with power distribution, battery management and electronic troubleshooting.
* Develop and test embedded control systems.

3. Robotics Programming & Autonomous Navigation

* Develop robotic control software using Python and C/C++.
* Work with ROS/ROS 2 for robotic communication, control and navigation.
* Implement motion control, locomotion, obstacle avoidance and path planning.
* Support SLAM, sensor fusion and autonomous navigation.
* Integrate real-time sensor data with robotic control systems.

4. AI & Computer Vision Integration

* Integrate cameras and AI vision systems into robotic platforms.
* Support object detection, human detection, obstacle recognition and intelligent surveillance applications.
* Work with OpenCV, PyTorch, TensorFlow or YOLO-based detection systems.
* Assist with deploying AI models on edge computing devices.
* Support integration with Mirador AI for intelligent perimeter surveillance and automated alerts.

5. Prototype Assembly & Testing

* Assemble complete robotic prototypes from mechanical and electronic components.
* Perform hardware and software integration.
* Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical and programming issues.
* Conduct controlled indoor and outdoor testing.
* Document engineering designs, test results, component specifications and improvements.

Required Qualifications

Students pursuing or recently completing:

* B.E./B.Tech – Robotics & Automation
* Mechatronics Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Electrical & Electronics Engineering
* Computer Science / Artificial Intelligence

Students from other disciplines with demonstrated robotics project experience are also welcome.

Essential Skills

Candidates should have practical experience in
**at least two**
of the following areas:

* Mechanical design and CAD modelling
* Robotics hardware assembly and fabrication
* Embedded systems and motor control
* Python, C/C++ or ROS 2
* Sensors, actuators and electronic integration
* Autonomous navigation or computer vision

Preferred Experience

Preference will be given to candidates who have:

* Built a working robotic prototype independently or as part of a team.
* Participated in robotics competitions, hackathons or university robotics clubs.
* Developed quadruped robots, robotic arms, mobile robots, drones or autonomous vehicles.
* Worked with 3D printing, electronics prototyping and hardware debugging.
* Published robotics projects on GitHub or maintained technical project portfolios.

**Previous commercial work experience is not mandatory. Demonstrated practical capability is more important than academic grades alone.**

What We Expect

We are specifically looking for interns who are:

* **Hands-on builders**
  , not just theoretical learners.
* Capable of understanding an engineering requirement and quickly developing a functional prototype.
* Comfortable assembling, programming, testing and troubleshooting hardware.
* Able to work independently while collaborating with mechanical, electronics and AI teams.
* Interested in contributing directly to real product development.
* Disciplined about engineering documentation, safe testing and meeting project milestones.

Selection Process

**Stage 1 – Project Portfolio Review**

Candidates must submit photographs, videos, GitHub repositories or technical descriptions of robotics projects they have personally developed.

**Stage 2 – Technical Interview**

Assessment of mechanical design, electronics, embedded systems, robotics programming and troubleshooting skills.

**Stage 3 – Practical Engineering Assessment**

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small, time-bound robotics design or programming task using accessible tools and equipment.

**Stage 4 – Final Selection**

Selection based on technical capability, practical experience, problem-solving skills and readiness to contribute to active projects.

Internship Benefits

* Work on real-world robotics and autonomous systems.
* Hands-on exposure to mechanical design, electronics, AI and robotic software development.
* Opportunity to contribute to the development of AerX robotic products.
* Technical mentoring and collaborative engineering experience.
* Internship completion certificate based on successful participation.
* Potential consideration for full-time engineering opportunities based on performance and business requirements.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit:

1. Updated resume.
2. Details of robotics projects completed.
3. Photographs or videos demonstrating working prototypes.
4. GitHub, CAD portfolio or other relevant technical work.
5. Availability and preferred internship duration.

**Email:**
hr@miradortechnologies.ai

**Subject:**
Application – Robotics Design & Development Internship – AerX Space Labs

**AerX Space Labs**

*Design. Build. Program. Innovate.*

**We are looking for students who don't just study robotics — they build robots.**

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

 As a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce Technical Senior at EY GDS, you will contribute to the success of enterprise\-scale D365 F\&O implementations, primarily in the Retail and commerce domain. You will have the opportunity to work with a growing team and play a key role in delivering financial transformation solutions, process improvements, and ERP implementations to global clients, helping build a better working world.

* Build and maintain strong client relationships through value\-driven consulting, technical leadership, and proactive engagement.

* Collaborate with functional consultants to translate business needs into detailed technical designs and functional design documents (FDDs).
* Utilize Azure DevOps and Lifecycle Services (LCS) for source control, CI/CD pipelines, and environment management.
* Support system testing, performance tuning, deployment, and go\-live activities.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce best development practices, and maintain thorough technical documentation.
* Provide Level 3 support post\-go\-live to resolve POS\-related issues and ensure smooth store operations.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

* Familiarity with Power Platform, especially Power Apps and Power BI, is a plus.

* Experience in conducting GAP analysis, solution testing, and user training.
* Good understanding of security roles, data management, Azure DevOps, and LCS environments.

* Knowledge of integration with other Microsoft technologies such as Azure, Power Platform.
* Familiarity with industry\-specific retail practices and compliance requirements.
* Experience working in multi\-country and multi\-legal entity environments.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven ability to lead discovery workshops, manage offshore teams, and mentor junior consultants.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global, fast\-paced environment.

* 5–10 years of experience in D365 Commerce technical.
* Minimum 3 full\-cycle D365 F\&O implementations in Commerce domains.
* Strong domain knowledge of Retail \& eCommerce
* Strong domain knowledge of D365 Site builder tool
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with a focus on performance and reliability.
* Experience with Microsoft SureStep, Agile, or hybrid implementation methodologies.
* Proficiency in working with globally distributed teams and stakeholders.
* Microsoft certifications such as MB\-340, MB\-900 are preferred.

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
